governanceNotes: D1 batch 65 (2026-09-26): identity deferred (IDENTITY-DUPLICATION with the interstitial-lung-disease/pulmonary-fibrosis windows plus CTD-association confounding). NSIP is a histopathologic/radiologic pattern within the interstitial lung disease family, and the located evidence supports no outgoing catalog edge: (i) pulmonary hypertension - the located PH-in-ILD evidence is Group 3 PH framing and CTD-ILD cohorts (myositis, RA, Sjogren) without NSIP-pattern-specific incident quantification, while the published interstitial-lung-disease and pulmonary-fibrosis pulmonary-hypertension windows already carry the pathway (identity-duplication guard; no evidence recycled from them per ME-29); (ii) respiratory failure and acute exacerbation - the genuine severe outcomes of progressive NSIP have NO catalog identities (withheld propositions, not deferred identities); (iii) pulmonary fibrosis - fibrotic NSIP is within-pattern (constitutive proximity) and the acute-interstitial-pneumonia pulmonary-fibrosis window is a different histotype's evidence; (iv) etiology confounding - most located NSIP cohorts are connective-tissue-disease-associated, where the CTD (scleroderma, myositis, Sjogren) is the etiologic driver and its own windows govern; (v) pattern-prognosis comparisons (NSIP versus UIP survival differences) are prognostic-stratification findings, not secondary-condition edges. Reopening conditions: (a) an idiopathic-NSIP cohort (CTD excluded) quantifying a catalog-fit secondary outcome with baseline PFT severity and treatment adjustment; or (b) a governance decision treating NSIP as a pattern facet of the interstitial-lung-disease identity rather than a standalone mapping source, consistent with the acute-interstitial-pneumonia sibling's partial separation.
